questions.question_bn: Nucleus mass number 36, total binding energy 288MeV। binding per nucleon কত MeV?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Average binding=B/A=(32×(9))/(4×(9))=8MeV per nucleon। total energy ও average আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: P-V rectangle cycle pressure 2P→5P, volume V→3 V; clockwise। PV=3 J। net work কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Cycle work enclosed area ΔPΔV=(3P)(2 V)=6PV=6×(3) J। clockwise positive work by gas।

questions.question_bn: F(x)=2x N, mass 5 kg rest থেকে x=0→3 m। final speed² কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Work ∫₀³2x dx=9 J。 work-energy ½mv²=9⇒v²=18/(5)।

questions.question_bn: Same star distance d→7d। observed flux ratio new/old কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Inverse-square flux F=L/(4πd²)। luminosity unchanged, distance factor (7) gives flux 1/(7)²।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Same liquid wetting tubes radii r ও 5r। rise height ratio first/second কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Jurin law h=2Tcosθ/(ρgr)। same liquid/contact angle-এ h∝1/r; ratio=(5)।

questions.question_bn: Simple magnifier f=25/8 cm, eye near-point 25 cm। final image at near-point হলে angular magnification কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Near-point magnification M=1+D/f=1+25/(25/(8))=(8)+1; infinity-image case M=D/f।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Circular coil radius RcentreB₀। same coil on axis distance√3R,B/B₀ কত? current 7A
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। OnaxisB/B₀=R³/(R²+x²)^(3/2)=(1+3)^(-3/2)=1/8। current cancels ratio।

questions.question_bn: 5 mol monatomic ideal-gas constant pressure heat 50RJ যোগ। ΔU কত J?

questions.question_bn: Masses M ও 4M, separation 27 m। তাদের মাঝে M থেকে কত দূরে net field zero?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। GM/x²=4GM/(3×(9)−x)²⇒3×(9)−x=2x⇒x=(9)। ছোট mass-এর কাছে balance।

questions.question_bn: Wire volume ও resistivity constant; length 8 গুণ stretch। Rnew/Rold কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Volume AL constant⇒area A/(8)। R=ρL/A⇒factor (8)/(1/(8))=(8)²।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: পরস্পর লম্ব বল 15 ও 20 N N। resultant-এর magnitude কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Orthogonal resultant R=√((3×(5))²+(4×(5))²)=5×(5)। সাধারণ যোগে 7×(5) ভুল।

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 28×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 28। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (28)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((28)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।

questions.question_bn: Principal shell n=6। maximum orbital count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Shell includes l=0…(6)−1। orbital sum Σ(2l+1)=(6)²। electron capacity 2×(6)², orbitals নয়।

questions.question_bn: Fe₂O₃+3CO→2Fe+3CO₂। Fe₂O₃amount 22 mol complete conversion। CO₂mol কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Balanced reaction 1Fe₂O₃gives 3CO₂। stoichiometric mole factor 3; iron yield 2nalternateseparateproduct।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 44 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 22 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Initial H⁺0.2×(22) mmol, OH⁻0.1×(22) mmol; excess 0.1×(22) mmol,total 3×(22) mL। concentration 0.1/3=1/30M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: HCl1.0×10⁻²M-কে 22 গুণ volume dilute। water ionisation negligible। pH কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Strong acid [H⁺]=10⁻²/(22)। pH=−log(10⁻²/(22))=2+logn; dilution pH বাড়ায়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Diluted water initial DO8mg/L, after 5days 6mg/L; sample fraction 1/17, blank correction 0। BOD₅ কত mg/L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। DO depletion=2mg/L in diluted mixture। Original sample BOD=(DOinitial−DOfinal)/fraction=2nmg/L।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ozone decomposition 2O₃→3O₂। 8 mol ozone fully decomposes। total gas mole increase কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। FinalO₂=(3/2)(8)। initial gas (8), increase=(3/2)(8)−(8)=(8)/2; final mole ও increment আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Acyclic alkane C11H24 complete combustion-এ 1 mol fuel-এর O₂ requirement কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। CₙH₂ₙ₊₂→nCO₂+((11)+1)H₂O। oxygen atoms 3×(11)+1⇒O₂=(3×(11)+1)/2 mol; water oxygen ও ধরতে হয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=24D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 24। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।

questions.question_bn: Same charge passes Ag⁺ ও Cu²⁺ cellsseries। depositedmoles Ag=17। Cumoles কত?

questions.question_bn: 1300g brine 10%w/w Na Cl। solvent water mass কত g?

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻5M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(5)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।

questions.question_bn: AcidicKMnO₄ 10mmol fullyoxidises Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺। Fe²⁺amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। MnO₄⁻acidic Mn²⁺-এ 5electronaccepts। each Fe²⁺oneelectronloses⇒5Fe²⁺perpermanganate।

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=13×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((13)×10⁻²)=(1/(13))×10⁻⁸M।

questions.question_bn: 2SO₂+O₂→2SO₃। SO₂amount 7molfullyconvert। oxygen needed কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। CoefficientratioO₂:SO₂=1:2। needn/2molO₂; oxygen atom count molecular count distinct ion।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Gas volume 27L at300 K,1atm। final 600 K,4atm। final volume কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 27। Fixed gas amount combined law V₂/V₁=(T₂/T₁)(P₁/P₂)=2·¼=½। Celsius ব্যবহার নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Stock 17M। first 10fold,then 5folddilution। final molarity কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। Sequentialdilutionfactorsmultiply 10×5=50। finalC=Cstock/50, factorsaddition 15 ভুল।

questions.question_bn: এক fat molecule-এ 10 C=C bond।1 mol fat fully hydrogenate করতে H₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Each C=C accepts 1H₂ on catalytic hydrogen at ion। প্রতি molecule ndoublebond→1 mol fat-এর জন্য (10) molH₂।

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=17M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(17)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((17)−1), initial concentration নয়।

questions.question_bn: CathodereductionE°=4/10 V,anodereductionE°=−0.20 V। E°cell কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Ecell=Ecathode(reduction)−Eanode(reduction)=(4)/10−(−0.2)=((4)+2)/10 V; addoppositesigns।

questions.question_bn: CH₄combustionreleases 890kJ/mol; amount 13 mol,burnerefficiency 80%। useful heat কত kJ?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। Totalcombustionheat 890nkJ। useful fraction 0.8⇒712nkJ; heatrelease sign separate from positive useful amount।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Air1m³-এ pollutant gas 8 cm³, sameT,P। volume ppm কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। 1m³=10⁶cm³। ppmV=((8)/10⁶)×10⁶=(8); amount volume ratio একই conditions-এ।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: প্রতি molecule-এ 9 টি independent C≡C, অন্য unsaturation নেই।1 mol sample fully hydrogenate করতে H₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। প্রতি triple bond-এ twoπbonds; alkane পর্যন্ত saturation-এর জন্য 2H₂। মোট 2×(9) mol, semihydrogenation-এ(9)।

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=14, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।

questions.question_bn: Neutral closed-shell formula C16H31N। IHD কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Nitrogen formula IHD=(2C+2+N−H)/2। [2((14)+2)+2+1−(2×(14)+3)]/2=2। halogens থাকলে H equivalent কমাতে হয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: HaberprocessN₂input 23 mol,H₂excess,singlepassN₂conversion 25%। NH₃out কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। ReactedN₂=(23)/4 mol。 N₂→2NH₃mole factor 2⇒NH₃(23)/2 mol; unreactedN₂recyclingwouldadditionalpasses।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Water Ca²⁺ 27mmol। soap RCOO⁻ stoichiometric precipitate Ca(RCOO)₂ হলে soap anion কত mmol consumed?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 27। Charge-balanced salt requires 2monovalent carboxylate per Ca²⁺। nmmol Ca consumes 2×(27) mmolsoap।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Preservative stock 2%w/v। final 500 mL0.10%w/v solution-এ stock কত mL?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Concentration dilution C₁V₁=C₂V₂⇒Vstock=0.10·100×(5)/2=5×(5) mL; তারপর final volume adjust।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 16 mol primary alcohol RCH₂OH fully oxidise toRCOOH। total electron loss কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Alcohol carbon oxidation state increases 4units toacid। half-reaction 4electron per alcohol; aldehyde পর্যন্ত 2electron।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 72mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 18mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। HClconsumed=4×(18)−(18)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Acidic Cr₂O₇²⁻ 10mmol→2Cr³⁺। total electron accepted কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Two Cr each+6→+3 needs 3electron; anion total 6electron。 oxygenbalance H⁺/waterdoesnotchangeelectrons।
questions.subject: Chemistry
